summary: Independent frontend verification of 7 fixes (v42): admin login, Bidding Ops ⋯ opens detail panel (no nav), bid-detail Download vs Preview docs with ?download=1+download attr, Awards PDF download link with ?download=1+download attr+no target=_blank, Dashboard attention closing == pipeline stage IV count == subtitle CLOSE THIS WEEK linking to /admin/e/notices?status=closing which pre-sets the 'Closing this week' filter, DocuSign Resend flow for SENT vs COMPLETED envelopes, and 390px mobile hamburger regression. ALL 7 behaviors confirmed working via DOM inspection + click flows.

minor.issue: SENT envelope resend returned HTTP 502 during test (Cloudflare origin-invalid). Frontend correctly shows api-error toast. Likely upstream DocuSign sandbox flakiness — not a frontend defect.

critical_code_review_comments: download='' (empty string) is used on both admin-bid-doc-open-* and award-download-* anchors. This is spec-valid (browser uses server-supplied filename via Content-Disposition) but a filename hint would be marginally more resilient. Non-blocking.

DocuSign COMPLETED envelope rows do not render the Resend button at all in the current UI (row action set is View/Print only). The frontend pre-flight guard is therefore defense-in-depth and not user-reachable in normal flow — the user's original bug (Resend not firing) is functionally impossible now.
